name: Ledger
line: A reference-book spread: an alphabetical index of exposures and cancer types on the left page (letter initials in the margin, group swatches, cause and link columns with dotted leaders) and the real network pinned on the right page; a reading line crosses the index as you scroll and the entry it touches lights up in the web with its links and names, the search filters the index in place, and the lesson closes the index as a ledger table while the web shows Tobacco smoking and Processed meat.
notes: The index shows a representative selection of 62 entries (every entry with five or more links plus well-known ones such as aspartame, processed meat and night-shift work) so the scroll stays near two to three screens; 'Show the full index' lists all of them. The index is the search's result list: arrows move through the filtered entries, Enter opens the card. On phones the web is pinned on top (40% of the screen), the search sticks under it and the index scrolls beneath, with the reading line just below the search. Both families cover Cyrillic. Without JavaScript the index and the still network drawing remain.
